facts.form: sleeveless dress with attached drape and accessories; raw unfinished edges at drape, ties and hem

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9505 festive, carnival or other entertainment articles; ch.95 note 1(e) excludes only well-made textile fancy dress of ch.61/62, and these raw-edged, flimsy garments are not well made

rejected_alternatives.reason: well-made apparel of ch.61/62; raw unfinished edges mean not well made

missing_facts: Fiber content and knit/woven construction not stated
classification.rationale: Raw, unfinished edges show the dress is not well made so note 1(e) to ch.95 does not exclude it; similar goddess costumes classified in 9505.90.6000.
